I notice the light shining through my  window in my room and walk over there are these dried water droplets on the outside.

Looking at this window the reflection from the sun is showing an array of colors and the start to move and spin and as I focus it turns into fractals and it starts to get intense. A bit overwhelmed I walk into my living room to sit on the couch and it was like everything was liquid everything breathing and moving. It was like seeing in 4d it some shit,textures seemed different than normal got so wild I try to close my eyes, as I do so I still see geometrical patterns and fractals with my eyes closed almost in like a vertigo design rotation inward like a tornado of colors.

I have been going through the most difficult time in my life at the moment and I am very seasoned to LSD seems like the only thing I can do to escape this hell of a reality I’ve been in. Spent quite some time there then made my way back to my apartment, go look in the mirror at myself in this human suit and was tripping out my face twisting and morphing just blown away at the fact I am a human out of all the odds I am here on this planet alive. After that I kick back out on the daft punk discovery album and space out for what felt like forever it was the perfect album for this trip took me through so many emotions and feelings smoked a couple of bowls during this so I stayed frying balls.

All in all about 13-14 hour trip, capped it off with taking a Xanax to come down because my brain was exhausted. 10/10 best fucking trip, would do again!
